title: CIC Compensation Decimator
text: Compensate for CIC filter using FIR decimator, 1 input, 1 output, no direct feedthrough, {Rounding mode} sets Rounding mode for output fixed-point operations; {Rate change factor} sets the rate-change factor of the CIC filter, {Number of sections}, {Differential delay}, {Decimation factor}, {Minimum order filter design} sets the design compensation filter of minimum order or of specified, {Filter order} sets the order of compensation filter, {Passband edge frequency (Hz)} sets the passband edge frequency of compensation, {Stopband edge frequency (Hz)} sets the stopband edge frequency of compensation, {Passband ripple (dB)} sets the passband ripple of compensation filter, {Stopband attenuation (dB)} sets the stopband attenuation of compensation, {Sample rate mode} sets the mode to specify the input sample rate Use normalized, {Input sample rate (Hz)} sets the sample rate of input signal, {Allow arbitrary frame length for fixed-size input signals}, {View Filter Response}, {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run Interpreted and {Coefficients} sets the word and fraction lengths of coefficients. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Output
ports.summary: Filtered and downsampled signal vector | matrix

params.name: Rate change factor
params.values: Rate-change factor of the CIC filter 2 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Number of sections
params.values: Number of sections in the CIC filter 2 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Differential delay
params.values: Differential delay of the CIC filter 1 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Decimation factor
params.values: Decimation factor of compensation filter 2 (default) | positive integer scalar

params.name: Minimum order filter design
params.values: Design compensation filter of minimum order or of specified order on (default) | off

params.name: Filter order
params.values: Order of compensation filter 12 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Passband edge frequency (Hz)
params.values: Passband edge frequency of compensation filter 100000 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Stopband edge frequency (Hz)
params.values: Stopband edge frequency of compensation filter 400000 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Passband ripple (dB)
params.values: Passband ripple of compensation filter 0.1 (default) | positive real scalar

params.name: Stopband attenuation (dB)
params.values: Stopband attenuation of compensation filter 60 (default) | positive real scalar

params.name: Sample rate mode

params.name: Input sample rate (Hz)
params.values: Sample rate of input signal 1200000 (default) | positive real scalar

params.name: Allow arbitrary frame length for fixed-size input signals
params.values: Allow arbitrary frame length for fixed-size input signals off (default) | on

params.values: Rounding mode for output fixed-point operations Floor (default) | Ceiling | Convergent | Nearest | Round | Simplest | Zero
